tools.name: recent_saves
tools.description: List posts imported into the authenticated user's AgentMash library within the last N days, newest imports first. Use for a recent library recap. Dates reflect import time, which can differ from when the user originally saved a post. Returns up to limit results. Read-only; calls count toward account

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_saves, get_save, recent_saves, list_sources, list_collections, get_collection_saves · Public sink: get_save, recent_saves, list_sources, list_collections.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_saves, get_save, recent_saves, list_sources, list_collections, get_collection_saves · Public sink: get_save, recent_saves, list_sources, list_collections

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
